record.question: Which of the following is the best explanation regarding the relationship between compliance and "bias toward the null" in a clinical trial?
options: Noncompliance will make the groups appear to be MORE similar, and the apparent strength of association will be diminished.
Noncompliance will make the groups appear to be LESS similar, and the apparent strength of association will appear to be stronger than it really is.
Noncompliance has no effect (a null effect) on the relative risk.
